caption: The drawing depicts a square composition comprised of smaller squares and triangles, resembling a patchwork quilt pattern. The center and four corners each contain a green square filled with a repeated red and yellow floral or berry motif. Surrounding and interspersed among these are triangles and squares in various colors and patterns, including solid sections of black, yellow, pink, purple, red, and blue, as well as multicolored and patterned sections with stripes, dots, checks, and small floral or geometric designs. The overall arrangement is symmetrical, with the shapes fitting together into a larger square, all outlined by a thin black border. The background surrounding the central square is a plain cream or beige color, with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Quilt Section
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
